lines.beaver_en: Hello! Is this your first time at the club?
lines.en: Yes, it's my first time at the photo club.

lines.beaver_en: Nice to meet you. Do you like taking photos?
lines.en: Yes, my special talent is taking photos.

lines.beaver_en: Wow, cool. Where do you usually shoot?
lines.en: I often shoot at amusement parks or playgrounds.

lines.beaver_en: Interesting. What do you do on weekends?
lines.en: On weekends, I go for a drive with a friend.

lines.beaver_en: Drives are nice. Do you have other hobbies?
lines.en: I like baduk. I sometimes go to arcades too.

lines.beaver_en: Wow, your tastes are really diverse!
lines.learner: 네, 근데 요즘은 사진이 더 좋아졌어요.
lines.en: Yes, but these days I've come to like photos more.
lines.roman: ne, geunde yojeumeun sajini deo joajyeosseoyo.

lines.learner: 잘 찍기 위해서 사진관에 다니고 책도 읽었어요.
lines.en: To take better pictures, I went to a photo studio and read books.
lines.roman: jal jjikgi wihaeseo sajingwane danigo chaekdo ilgeosseoyo.

lines.en: I read books written by a famous photographer.

lines.beaver_en: We're shooting at the park next week. Want to come?

lines.beaver: 좋아요. 그럼 다음 주 토요일에 봐요!
lines.beaver_en: Great. See you next Saturday, then!
lines.beaver_roman: joayo. geureom daeum ju toyoire bwayo!
lines.learner: 네, 제 취향 이야기 들어 줘서 고마워요!
lines.en: Okay, thanks for listening to me talk about my tastes!
lines.roman: ne, je chwihyang iyagi deureo jwoseo gomawoyo!
